title: RS Decoder
source_docs: Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/RS_Decoder.md
text: Decode and recover message from RS codeword, 3 inputs, 5 outputs; {Codeword length (N)} sets the length of codeword, {Message length (K)} sets the length of message, {Source of primitive polynomial} sets the primitive polynomial source, {Primitive polynomial}, {Source of B, the starting power for roots of the primitive polynomial} sets the source of starting power for roots of primitive, {B value} sets the starting power of roots, {Output number of corrected symbol errors} sets the number of corrected symbol errors and {Enable erasure input port}. Values come from the instance.
